Displays:
widstatus Workflow select distinct on (w.id) w.id as session_id, w.externalid, w.wrk_workflowdata_id, w.pipeline_name , w.status, w.status ||'#' || w.wrk_workflowdata_id AS widstatus from wrk_workflowdata w where replace(replace(w.pipeline_name, '.', '_'),' ','_')='@WHERE' order by w.id,launch_time desc
launch_time Workflow Launch select distinct on (w.id) w.id as session_id, w.externalid, w.wrk_workflowdata_id, w.pipeline_name , to_char(w.launch_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS launch_time from wrk_workflowdata w where replace(replace(w.pipeline_name, '.', '_'),' ','_')='@WHERE' order by w.id,launch_time desc
last_modified Workflow Last Mod select distinct on (w.id) w.id as session_id, w.externalid, w.wrk_workflowdata_id, w.pipeline_name , to_char(meta.last_modified,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_modified FROM wrk_workflowdata w LEFT JOIN wrk_workflowdata_meta_data meta ON w.workflowData_info=meta.meta_data_id where replace(replace(w.pipeline_name, '.', '_'),' ','_')='@WHERE' order by w.id,launch_time desc
>
NUM_WRKS Workflow Runs select distinct on (w.id) w.id as session_id, COUNT(*) AS NUM_WRKS from wrk_workflowdata w where replace(replace(w.pipeline_name, '.', '_'),' ','_')='@WHERE' GROUP BY session_id
file_size File Size by Resource SELECT xnat_experimentdata_id AS session_id, label, file_size FROM xnat_abstractResource abst JOIN xnat_experimentdata_resource res ON abst.xnat_abstractresource_id=res.xnat_abstractresource_xnat_abstractresource_id WHERE label='@WHERE' ORDER BY xnat_experimentdata_id
file_count File Count by Resource SELECT xnat_experimentdata_id AS session_id, label, file_count FROM xnat_abstractResource abst JOIN xnat_experimentdata_resource res ON abst.xnat_abstractresource_id=res.xnat_abstractresource_xnat_abstractresource_id WHERE label='@WHERE' ORDER BY xnat_experimentdata_id
file_count Scan count by type SELECT image_session_id, COUNT(*) AS file_count FROM xnat_imageScanData scan WHERE TYPE='@WHERE' GROUP BY image_session_id
